result.instructions: Tools for Reservio, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which free slots do we have for a haircut next Tuesday?"; "List the bookings created in the last 24 hours."; "Which staff members work on Friday, and what are their rosters?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Reservio data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run reservio_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run reservio_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run reservio_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. reservio_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: reservio_get_business
tools.title: Get a business
tools.description: Get the business profile: name, address, contact details, time zone. Reservio API: GET /businesses/{businessId}.

business_id.description: Business id. Default: the business you entered at login.

tools.name: reservio_list_services
tools.title: List services
tools.description: List the services clients can book, with duration, price and capacity. Reservio API: GET /businesses/{businessId}/services.

business_id.description: Business id. Default: the business you entered at login.

sort.description: Sort column, prefix - for descending, e.g. -createdAt.

filter.description: Filters as {"name": "Bob"}; each key becomes filter[key]=value (JSON:API).

offset.description: Number of items to skip, for paging.

tools.name: reservio_get_booking_slots
tools.title: Get free booking slots
tools.description: List free time slots for a service in a date range, optionally for one resource. Use before creating a booking. Reservio API: GET /businesses/{businessId}/availability/booking-slots.

business_id.description: Business id. Default: the business you entered at login.

resource_id.description: Limit to one resource (staff member), from reservio_list_resources.

business_id.description: Business id. Default: the business you entered at login.

resource_id.description: Limit to one resource (staff member), from reservio_list_resources.

tools.name: reservio_create_appointment_booking
tools.title: Create an appointment booking
tools.description: WRITE: create a real appointment booking for a service at a start/end time (use a slot from reservio_get_booking_slots). Reservio may notify the client. Not safe to repeat: a second call books a second appointment. Reservio API: POST /businesses/{businessId}/bookings.

business_id.description: Business id. Default: the business you entered at login.

tools.name: reservio_create_group_booking
tools.title: Book a group event
tools.description: WRITE: book a client into an existing group event (event id from reservio_list_events). Reservio may notify the client. Not safe to repeat: a second call books a second seat. Reservio API: POST /businesses/{businessId}/bookings.

business_id.description: Business id. Default: the business you entered at login.
